# Include web embed file list if it exists (generated by prepare_web.sh)
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../web_embed.cmake")
    include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../web_embed.cmake")
else()
    set(WEB_EMBED_FILES "")
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "main.cpp"
        "wifi_manager.cpp"
        "http_server.cpp"
        "roku_session.cpp"
        "roku_auth.cpp"
        "rtp_receiver.cpp"
        "ssdp_discovery.cpp"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES
        esp_http_server
        esp_wifi
        esp_netif
        nvs_flash
        mbedtls
        lwip
        esp_event
        esp_http_client
        json
        esp_driver_uart
        esp_driver_gpio
    EMBED_FILES
        ${WEB_EMBED_FILES}
)
